points.text: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences for macroeconomic models used to inform economic stabilization policy.
Federal agents searched Representative Ilhan Omar’s Washington home as part of a criminal investigation, weeks before the midterm elections.
A federal judge ordered the Trump administration to cancel remaining taxpayer-funded television ads, ruling they promoted the president’s political message.
Russell Brand’s trial on rape and sexual assault charges began at Southwark Crown Court; he has pleaded not guilty.
Microsoft President Brad Smith called for stronger global AI safety standards, including mandatory incident reporting.
